capabilities: play white noise sounds such as rain and coffee shop noise
control white noise volume independently of music
run a built-in pomodoro timer together with white noise
extras: The author modified and compressed sound assets from the Moodist project (removing some sounds and generating base noise dynamically) to reduce plugin size.
motivation: To help users focus better and enter a calmer working state.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play ambient background sound for focus while working in the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses sound materials from the Moodist project.

summary: Audio player that plays white noise such as rain or coffee shop sounds to help focus, with independent volume control and a built-in pomodoro timer.
